title: Miss probability after a cubic number of steps
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of degree $D>0$ on $V$, with $D\le 100|V|$. If $s$ can reach $t$ by a finite sequence of neighbor-slot steps, then the probability that a walk of length $1000|V|^3$, started at $s$ with each step choosing a neighbor slot uniformly, fails to visit $t$ is at most $1/10$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a finite regular multigraph of degree $D>0$
$s$ reaches $t$ by a finite sequence of neighbor-slot steps
